raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The pipeline keeps only status='POSTED' rows and never applies the 14 REVERSAL rows, whose orig_txn_id points to original POSTED transactions that were never netted out. Those reversed originals stay in silver and inflate the recent-day gold totals, which matches Finance's report. Fix: drop POSTED originals that have a REVERSAL row, using a NULL-safe filter because orig_txn_id contains nulls.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.55, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
